_readme: The daily guide job (tools/write-guide.mjs) writes the first topic here whose slug is not yet published, one a day. Reorder to change what comes next; add topics at the end. kind: mountain = a resort guide with live PeakWait lift data (resort = PeakWait slug, region = filter chip on /guides/), day = a planning decision, why = background. Geo priority from the ICP: Colorado Front Range, then Wasatch, then Tahoe, then the Northeast.

topics.topic: Colorado ski resort opening dates for the 2026-27 season
topics.angle: Every Colorado resort's announced opening day in one place, which ones open first, and what early season terrain is really like. Use the live PeakWait opening dates provided; say plainly when a resort has not announced.
